name: Stilled Hurricane
text: From the tenth trick on, opponents can't win a trick by trumping.

signature.target: spades played to tricks of another suit

archetypes: High Card, Exact Contractor, Nil Champion; splash Heart Chorus, While Held
family: Trump and spade-breaking rules / Timed trump (late)
decision: Which winners to hold for the last four tricks, where kings and queens are safe from voids, and when an opponent's late trumps have gone dead.
opponent: Public, so opponents plan around it; they answer by trumping early, before the tenth trick, or by leading spades late.
aiNote: Hold non-spade kings and queens for tricks 10–13; do not count spades as winners in those tricks except on spade leads; on nil, keep spades to shed late.
rationale: Late tricks are where voids appear, so this is the "Blue trump restriction for the late tricks" that High Card, Heart Chorus, and Diamond Flood's threat notes ask for; an opposing nil bidder forced to play spades late can't win with them, and your exact bids' last tricks become predictable. Your own late trumps still win.
deviation: Moved the window from the opening tricks to the last four, because fresh hands are rarely void early, so an early ban seldom changes a trick, while the archetype notes want trump restricted late.
